caption: This tonkotsu ramen features a rich, creamy broth cradling tender chashu pork and noodles, topped with fresh green onions. Served in a white bowl with black accents, it rests on a wooden table under warm, inviting light.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, smooth grain patterns, and subtle natural texture beneath the bowl.
The chashu pork is a thick, round slice with pale pinkish-white meat, visible marbling, and a slightly glistening surface.
The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy beige, glossy, and rich, swirling around noodles and toppings.
White ceramic ramen bowl with glossy finish, black brushstroke pattern, and smooth, slightly raised rim.
